# Fixture evidence

Every record in this directory is deliberately synthetic. It is shaped to exercise normalized entity reconstruction and does not claim to be a current LinkedIn response.

## profile-core
Hand-authored core identity, localized text, and media variants.

## experience
Hand-authored position-to-company reference resolution with two distinct roles. No promotion grouping is inferred.

## education
Hand-authored education record with partial dates.

## skills
Hand-authored skill entities.

## certifications
Hand-authored certification entity.

## languages
Hand-authored language entities.

The expected normalized benchmark file was independently authored from this written fixture specification before comparison; the benchmark never copies extractor output into expected data.
